name: Chicken Quinoa Bowl with Kale, Pickled Radish & Lemon-Tahini Sauce

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ lemons
3 medium carrots
1 ½ bunches kale

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, toss to combine, and set aside to marinate.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl.
Zest and juice lemons into the bowl with the garlic; add tahini, water, oil, and salt. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup tahini
⅓ cup water
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the skillet and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; transfer to a large plate.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the plate with the carrot.
To serve, divide quinoa between bowls; top with chicken, carrots, kale, pickled radish, and pistachios. Drizzle with lemon-tahini sauce and enjoy!
